title: color-contrast
guideline: Text must meet WCAG contrast minimums
do: Use 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (18px+ bold or 24px+)
dont: Placing gray-400 text on a white background

title: focus-states
guideline: Interactive elements need a visible focus ring
do: Use a 2px visible outline/ring with sufficient contrast on :focus-visible
dont: Removing outline:none without a replacement focus style

title: alt-text
guideline: Meaningful images need descriptive alt text
do: Describe the image's purpose/content in alt=''
dont: Leaving alt empty on informative images or stuffing keywords

title: aria-labels
guideline: Icon-only buttons need an accessible name
do: Add aria-label describing the action, e.g. aria-label='Close menu'
dont: Shipping an icon button with no discernible text for screen readers

title: keyboard-nav
guideline: All interactive elements must be keyboard reachable
do: Ensure logical tab order matching visual order; support Enter/Space
dont: Trapping focus in a modal with no escape, or skipping tabindex order

title: form-labels
guideline: Every input needs an associated label
do: Use <label for='id'> or aria-labelledby, not placeholder-only
dont: Using placeholder text as the only label (disappears on input)

title: semantic-html
guideline: Use semantic elements over generic divs
do: Use nav, main, header, button, etc. for their intended purpose
dont: Using <div onClick> instead of <button> for actions

title: skip-links
guideline: Provide a skip-to-content link
do: Add a visually-hidden-until-focused 'Skip to main content' link
dont: Forcing keyboard users to tab through the entire nav every page

title: error-identification
guideline: Form errors must be programmatically associated
do: Use aria-describedby to link error text to its input
dont: Showing error text visually with no association for screen readers

title: heading-hierarchy
guideline: Headings must follow a logical, non-skipping order
do: Use h1 > h2 > h3 in document order for structure
dont: Skipping heading levels purely for font-size convenience

title: touch-target-size
guideline: Touch targets must be large enough to hit reliably
do: Minimum 44x44px (iOS) / 48x48dp (Android) tappable area
dont: Small icon buttons packed tightly with no spacing

title: hover-vs-tap
guideline: Primary actions must not depend on hover
do: Use click/tap as the primary trigger; hover is progressive enhancement
dont: Hiding a critical action behind hover-only reveal on touch devices

title: loading-buttons
guideline: Disable buttons during async operations
do: Show a spinner and disable the button while the request is in flight
dont: Allowing repeat clicks that fire duplicate form submissions

title: error-feedback
guideline: Errors must appear near the point of failure
do: Show inline error messages next to the offending field
dont: Showing only a generic top-of-page banner for a specific field error

title: cursor-pointer
guideline: Clickable elements need a pointer cursor
do: Add cursor-pointer/cursor: pointer to all clickable elements
dont: Leaving the default cursor on a clickable card or row

title: tap-feedback
guideline: Taps need immediate visual feedback
do: Use an active/pressed state (opacity/scale) on tap
dont: No visual acknowledgment that a tap registered

title: swipe-affordance
guideline: Swipeable content needs a visible affordance
do: Peek the next item or add dots/arrows to hint swipeability
dont: A fully swipeable carousel with no visual hint it's swipeable

title: destructive-confirmation
guideline: Destructive actions need confirmation
do: Require a confirm step (dialog) for delete/irreversible actions
dont: One-tap delete with no undo or confirmation

title: image-optimization
guideline: Images should be optimized and responsive
do: Use WebP/AVIF, srcset, and lazy loading below the fold
dont: Shipping full-resolution PNGs with no lazy loading

title: reduced-motion
guideline: Respect the user's reduced-motion preference
do: Wrap non-essential animation in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
dont: Forcing parallax/auto-play animation regardless of OS setting

title: content-jumping
guideline: Reserve space for async content
do: Set explicit width/height or aspect-ratio before content loads
dont: Letting images/ads load in and shift layout (high CLS)

title: font-loading
guideline: Fonts shouldn't cause invisible text or big shifts
do: Use font-display: swap and preload critical fonts
dont: Blocking render on web font load with no fallback

title: code-splitting
guideline: Ship only what the current view needs
do: Lazy-load routes/heavy components (charts, editors, modals)
dont: Bundling every page's JS into a single blocking initial payload

title: debounce-input
guideline: Expensive input handlers should be debounced
do: Debounce search/filter inputs that trigger network/heavy compute
dont: Firing an API call on every keystroke with no debounce

title: viewport-meta
guideline: Pages need a correct viewport meta tag
do: <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>
dont: Omitting the viewport tag, causing mobile browsers to zoom out

title: readable-font-size
guideline: Body text should be readable without zooming
do: Minimum 16px body text on mobile
dont: Using 12-13px body copy that forces users to pinch-zoom

title: horizontal-scroll
guideline: Content must fit the viewport width
do: Use max-width: 100%, overflow-x: auto only on intentional scroll areas
dont: Fixed-width elements causing unintended horizontal page scroll

title: z-index-management
guideline: Define a consistent z-index scale
do: Use a scale like 10/20/30/50 for dropdown/modal/toast/tooltip layers
dont: Ad-hoc z-index: 9999 sprinkled wherever something doesn't show

title: responsive-breakpoints
guideline: Test at standard breakpoints
do: Verify layout at 375, 768, 1024, 1440px widths
dont: Designing only for one desktop width and hoping it reflows

title: safe-area-insets
guideline: Respect device safe areas on mobile
do: Use env(safe-area-inset-*) for notches/home indicators
dont: Content hidden behind the iPhone notch or home indicator bar

title: empty-states
guideline: Every list/table needs a designed empty state
do: Show a helpful message + primary action when there's no data
dont: Rendering a blank white area when a list has zero items

title: floating-nav-spacing
guideline: Floating navbars need edge spacing
do: Add top-4/left-4/right-4 spacing instead of sticking to viewport edges
dont: Sticking a floating-style navbar flush to top-0 left-0 right-0

title: content-under-fixed-nav
guideline: Content must not hide behind fixed headers
do: Add top padding/margin to main content equal to navbar height
dont: Fixed navbar overlapping the first block of page content

title: line-height
guideline: Body text needs comfortable line-height
do: Use 1.5-1.75 line-height for paragraph text
dont: Tight 1.1-1.2 line-height on multi-line body copy

title: line-length
guideline: Limit line length for readability
do: Keep body text to 65-75 characters per line (max-w-prose)
dont: Full-bleed paragraph text stretching 150+ characters wide

title: font-pairing
guideline: Pair fonts with complementary personalities
do: Match a distinct heading font with a neutral, legible body font
dont: Using two competing display fonts for both heading and body

title: type-scale
guideline: Use a consistent modular type scale
do: Define a fixed scale (e.g. 12/14/16/20/24/32/48px)
dont: Ad-hoc font sizes chosen per-component with no system

title: color-not-only-indicator
guideline: Don't rely on color alone to convey meaning
do: Pair color with icons/text for status (success/error/warning)
dont: Red/green-only indicators that are invisible to colorblind users

title: dark-mode-glass-contrast
guideline: Glass/transparent surfaces need enough opacity in light mode
do: Use bg-white/80+ (not bg-white/10) for glass cards in light mode
dont: Using near-transparent white panels that vanish on light backgrounds

title: border-visibility
guideline: Borders must be visible in both themes
do: Use border-gray-200 in light mode, border-white/10 only in dark mode
dont: Using border-white/10 in light mode where it's effectively invisible

title: duration-timing
guideline: Micro-interactions should be fast, not sluggish
do: Use 150-300ms for hover/tap/toggle transitions
dont: 500ms+ transitions on simple hover states feel laggy

title: transform-performance
guideline: Animate cheap properties, not layout-triggering ones
do: Animate transform and opacity for smooth 60fps motion
dont: Animating width/height/top/left, forcing layout recalculation

title: loading-states
guideline: Async content needs a loading state
do: Use skeleton screens or spinners while data loads
dont: Blank screen with no feedback while a request is pending

title: easing-curves
guideline: Use natural easing, not linear
do: Use ease-out for entrances, ease-in for exits
dont: Linear easing on every transition, which feels robotic

title: purposeful-motion
guideline: Animation should communicate, not decorate
do: Use motion to show relationship/continuity (e.g. shared element transitions)
dont: Adding animation to every element with no functional purpose

title: style-match
guideline: Match visual style to product type and audience
do: Pick a style whose personality matches the product's context (e.g. corporate-clean for B2B finance)
dont: Applying a playful/brutalist style to a serious medical or legal product

title: consistency
guideline: Keep style consistent across all pages
do: Reuse the same spacing scale, radius, and color tokens sitewide
dont: Mixing glassmorphism on the homepage with flat design on the dashboard

title: no-emoji-icons
guideline: Use real icons, not emoji, for UI iconography
do: Use an SVG icon set (Heroicons, Lucide) sized consistently
dont: Using emoji like ⚙️ 🚀 🎨 as functional UI icons

title: icon-consistency
guideline: Icons should share one visual system
do: Use one icon library with a fixed viewBox (e.g. 24x24) throughout
dont: Mixing icon sets with different stroke widths and grids

title: brand-logo-accuracy
guideline: Third-party brand logos must be accurate
do: Source official SVGs (e.g. from Simple Icons) for brand marks
dont: Guessing or hand-drawing an approximation of a brand's logo

title: chart-type-match
guideline: Choose chart type based on the data relationship
do: Match trend->line, comparison->bar, composition->stacked/pie
dont: Using a pie chart for a time-series trend

title: chart-color-guidance
guideline: Use accessible, distinguishable chart colors
do: Use a colorblind-safe categorical palette with sufficient contrast
dont: Red/green as the only distinguishing colors between two series

title: chart-data-table
guideline: Provide a non-visual alternative to charts
do: Offer a toggle to a data table for screen-reader/keyboard users
dont: Charts with no way to access the underlying data non-visually

title: disabled-state-clarity
guideline: Disabled controls need a visibly distinct state
do: Reduce opacity and remove pointer affordance, add a tooltip if useful
dont: A disabled button that looks identical to an enabled one

title: undo-over-confirm
guideline: Prefer undo for low-risk reversible actions
do: Use a toast with 'Undo' instead of a blocking confirm dialog
dont: Interrupting every minor action with a confirmation modal

title: inline-validation-timing
guideline: Validate on blur/submit, not on every keystroke
do: Show validation errors after the user leaves the field or submits
dont: Flashing 'required' errors while the user is still typing

title: input-grouping
guideline: Group related fields visually
do: Use fieldset/legend or spacing to cluster related inputs
dont: A flat list of 20 unlabeled-grouped inputs in one long form

title: active-state-indication
guideline: Current page/section must be visually indicated
do: Highlight the active nav item with color/underline + aria-current
dont: Navigation with no indication of which page is currently active

title: breadcrumb-for-depth
guideline: Deep hierarchies need breadcrumbs
do: Show breadcrumbs for content nested 3+ levels deep
dont: No wayfinding in a deeply nested admin/docs hierarchy

title: toast-timing
guideline: Toasts should stay long enough to read
do: Keep toasts visible 4-6s, longer for multi-line messages
dont: Toasts that auto-dismiss in under 2 seconds
